calendar_scrap.label: Calendar Scrap
calendar_scrap.description: Torn March calendar — 17 circled, 3:17 in the margin. Program stub glued on back: …recital …3:17 PM. Sacred minute or missed appointment. Your hand either way.

photo_set.label: Photo Backs
photo_set.description: Four wallet photos, faces turned away on the fronts. Letters scrambled on the cardboard backs. Family or cipher — you stopped telling the difference.

receipt_stub.label: Receipt Stub
receipt_stub.description: Stillpoint Sleep Lab — intake deposit. Same date as the calendar. Real place, filed metaphor, or both. Track A scripture. Track B paperwork from the year you stopped going out.

key_blade.label: Key Blade
key_blade.description: Narrow brass blade without a handle. Delusion: key to next truth. Memory: key to the closet where her gift was kept.

key_handle.label: Key Handle
key_handle.description: Worn wooden grip, snapped off something domestic. Rest — where the head falls — where this piece waited.

assembled_key.label: Assembled Key
assembled_key.description: Blade and handle joined. Fits the wardrobe latch. Opens doctrine and old coats in the same motion.

cipher_disk.label: Cipher Disk
cipher_disk.description: Cardboard wheel with cut-out windows. Align STILL with POINT. Sacred diagram. Door wants the full name: STILLPOINT.

stillpoint_letter.label: Stillpoint Letter
stillpoint_letter.description: Folded consent — Project Stillpoint, voluntary memory containment during lucid REM. Your signature. Reads like a trial. Feels like signing away the people who knocked.

phone.label: Phone
phone.description: No signal. Screen frozen on one notification: You chose to forget. Voicemail waiting — her voice, older: Dad, if you get this… Catalogued as Relic Seven. Never played.
